question: When can you use the right lane of a two-lane carriageway?

options.text: When your path of travel is obstructed by road works or parked vehicles.
When your speed is higher that the speed limit for the road.
When the right lane is free of traffic.

notes: Source typo in option B: 'higher that' (should be 'higher than').

question: Pre-driving checks

options.text: Will reduce the chances of breakdown.
Should be done only when the vehicle misfires.
Are not necessary if it is a new vehicle.

question: Which of the following maintenance parts could cause an accident if the fluid level is low?

options.text: Battery.
Engine.
Brake reservoir.

question: If your car skids while braking, you should

options.text: Step harder on the brake pedal.
Release the brake pedal and apply it again.
Pull up the handbrake.

question: In the vicinity of a hospital, you should sound the horn

options.text: Only to warn other road users the danger of an accident.
To let others know that you have the right of way.
If another vehicle moved into your lane without signalling.

notes: Option A reads 'warn other road users the danger' (missing 'of') as printed in source.

question: When your car breaks down on an expressway, you should

options.text: Move your car to the road shoulder.
Leave your car on the expressway with the boot cover fully opened.
Leave your car on the expressway with the bonnet fully opened.

question: What should you do if you see a cyclist riding against the flow of traffic towards you?

options.text: Sound your horn to warn him of the danger.
Slow down and be ready to stop if necessary.
Stop Immediately.

notes: Option C has capital 'I' in 'Immediately' as printed in source.

question: A cyclist with a heavy load is wobbling along the road, you should

options.text: Drive closer to warn him it is dangerous.
Give him more space when passing.
Not pass him at all.

question: Before making a lane change to your left, you must signal for at least 3 second and

options.text: Use your vehicle brake lights to warn other road users.
Use your vehicle hazard lights to warn other road users.
Check your blind spot before moving left.

notes: Source typo in question: '3 second' (should be '3 seconds').

question: Before turning right into a minor road, you should

options.text: Slow down or stop to give way to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians.
Slow down and turn sharply.
Not give way to oncoming vehicle.

question: If the foot-brake pedal moves all the way to the floor, it is a sign that the foot-brake

options.text: Is working.
May be faulty.
Is normal.

question: If the medicines prescribe by the doctor are likely to affect your driving, you should

options.text: Drive only if someone is with you.
Not to drive yourself.
Avoid driving on the expressway..

notes: Source typo in question: 'prescribe' (should be 'prescribed'). Option C ends with a double full stop in source.

question: If you are feeling very tired and sleepy whilst driving on an expressway, you should

options.text: Make an exit and stop at a safe place to rest.
Stop at the road shoulder to rest.
Switch on hazard lights and drive slowly along the road shoulder.

question: Before making a left turn in a narrow course, you should position your car

options.text: More to the left.
More to the right.
At the centre of the course.

question: If you see an oily patch on the road, you should

options.text: Slow down.
Speed up.
Avoid it if possible.

question: Some of the common vehicle defects that can cause accidents are

options.text: Faulty seat belts, seats, child restraint and alarm system.
Faulty tyres, brakes, shock absorbers and windscreen wipers.
Dull paint, dented bumpers and old seats.

question: During weekdays (Monday to Friday) in the morning, vehicles other than omnibuses are not allowed to enter the bus lane from

options.text: 7.00 am to 9.00 am.
7.00 am to 9.30 am.
7.30 am to 9.30 am.

question: Before turning right at this intersection, you should
picture: Video frame from driver's seat approaching an intersection with a traffic light and a blue circular sign

options.text: Stop to ensure safety.
Wait for the green traffic signal light to come on.
Not to stop or wait for the green traffic signal light to come on.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button; only a single still frame is available.

question: Both cars are turning right at this intersection. What path should they take?
picture: Top-down video frame of a crossroads with a yellow car and a white car approaching from opposite directions

options.text: Both cars pass in front of each other.
Pass behind each other.
Choose either depending on the traffic flow.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button; the frame shows turn-path arrows that may hint at the answer.

question: A person will be disqualified from driving if he is caught

options.text: Driving with a blood alcohol concentration over 80 mg of alcohol/100ml of blood.
Failing to obey a 'Stop' traffic sign.
Failing to give way to an ambulance with its siren on.
